description: A tiling window manager for Windows, with an animation engine, a status bar, a command palette and a configuration language that tells you when you have made a mistake.
notes: Shubbak is installed but not running. One command finishes the job:
shubbak setup                write a starter config, start at logon, start now
Then alt+shift+space opens the palette, and ? inside it lists every key.
'shubbak doctor' checks the install; 'shubbak config-path' says which file is in
effect. The fully annotated reference is shubbak.example.kdl, beside the executables.
This is the portable build, under your profile, so it cannot move windows that
belong to elevated programs; the MSI from the releases page (or
'winget install shubbak') can. Run shubbak-wm elevated if you need those tiled
pre_uninstall: if (Get-Process shubbak-wm, taj, dalil, ayn -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { & "$dir\shubbak.exe" stop }
